summary: All 12 backend pytest cases pass against http://localhost:8001 for the two new server.py behaviors: (1) POST /api/register-push now captures the Emergent relay's upstream response (status_code=401 + body 'invalid X-Push-Key') into _last_push_events with kind='register' and still upserts to db.push_devices before re-raising HTTPException(500); (2) GET /api/debug/last-push-events HTML shows a kind badge (register|trigger) and switches the detail line accordingly. Verified newest-first ordering (trigger event after register events appears at the top), ring buffer bounded at 20 with a mix of register+trigger events, and full regression matrix (trigger-alert, debug/devices, debug/test-push GET+POST, legacy /api/status, send_push HTTPException(500) contract on upstream 401).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 117 vs 127: on the happy path (2xx from relay) the register event is only appended when resp.status_code returns successfully — but if resp.raise_for_status() throws on a non-2xx that ISN'T 401/5xx (e.g. 400/404), the event is appended TWICE (once at line 117 and again at line 127 in the except branch). Low-impact given placeholder key path always hits 401.

server.py line 28: PUSH_KEY = os.environ.get('EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY', 'placeholder') — silent fallback to literal 'placeholder' is fine for dev but hides misconfig in prod. Consider logging a WARNING on startup when PUSH_KEY == 'placeholder'.
seed_data_creation: Test users diag-A, diag-B, and TEST_ringmix_reg_* were upserted into db.push_devices during the run. No cleanup performed — they are harmless dev data (device tokens are placeholders) and coexist with the placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_register_push_capture.py. Uses subprocess supervisorctl restart backend between test classes to reset the module-level _last_push_events deque. If EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY becomes a real value, tests that assert 'invalid X-Push-Key' will fail — they specifically pin behavior under the placeholder key. Also test_c depends on test_a (both register diag-A/diag-B into the ring buffer) — do not reorder within TestRegisterPushCapturesUpstream.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification only. Both new behaviors match spec exactly: register events carry kind='register' + user_id/platform detail line, trigger events carry kind='trigger' + title/chunk_size detail line, and the upstream 401 body 'invalid X-Push-Key' is surfaced inside a <pre> block on each event card.
